_note: ETF/fund distribution registry for the dividend income calendar (Tier 2, yield-based). A held ticker listed here is projected from its yield x market value spread over the given cadence. 'yield' overrides the universe divyield when that is absent (fraction, e.g. 0.008 = 0.8%). months = calendar months a quarterly/annual payer distributes in. Stocks are NOT listed here — they come from the FMP dividends feed (Tier 1).
